package v1

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/hybridapplication"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type intentRouteCapture struct {
	creates, gets   int
	actor, path, id string
}

func (c *intentRouteCapture) CreateIntent(_ context.Context, actor, path string, input hybridapplication.CreateIntentInput) (domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt, error) {
	c.creates++
	c.actor = actor
	c.path = path
	c.id = input.IntentID
	return domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt{}, nil
}
func (c *intentRouteCapture) GetIntent(_ context.Context, actor, path, id string) (domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt, error) {
	c.gets++
	c.actor = actor
	c.path = path
	c.id = id
	return domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt{}, nil
}
func TestHybridIntentRegisteredLearnerActorAndStrictBody(t *testing.T) {
	actor, path, id := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	input := hybridapplication.CreateIntentInput{IntentID: id, ExpectedPathRevision: 3, Kind: "CHANGE_GOAL", RequestedChange: domain.HybridRequestedChange{Scope: domain.HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: "go.advanced", DirectionCode: "backend", DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}}, Mutations: []domain.HybridFutureMutation{}}}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(input)
	request := func(body, role, method, url string, capture *intentRouteCapture) (int, string) {
		r := chi.NewRouter()
		r.Use((middleware.AuthMiddleware{}).Middleware)
		RegisterHybridIntentRoutes(r, &handlers.StudentHybridIntentHandler{Intents: capture})
		req := httptest.NewRequest(method, url, strings.NewReader(body))
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		req.Header.Set("X-User-ID", actor)
		req.Header.Set("X-User-Role", role)
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		r.ServeHTTP(w, req)
		return w.Code, w.Body.String()
	}
	url := "/student/learning-paths/" + path + "/learning-intents"
	for _, role := range []string{"STUDENT", "STUDENT_PRO", "TEACHER", "ADMIN"} {
		capture := &intentRouteCapture{}
		status, _ := request(string(raw), role, "POST", url, capture)
		if role == "STUDENT" || role == "STUDENT_PRO" {
			if status != 200 || capture.creates != 1 || capture.actor != actor || capture.path != path || capture.id != id {
				t.Fatal("learner actor not bound")
			}
		} else if status != 403 || capture.creates != 0 {
			t.Fatal("Teacher/admin fabricated learner intent")
		}
	}
	capture := &intentRouteCapture{}
	status, _ := request("", "STUDENT", "GET", url+"/"+id, capture)
	if status != 200 || capture.gets != 1 || capture.actor != actor || capture.path != path || capture.id != id {
		t.Fatal("receipt read not actor/path bound")
	}
	cases := map[string]string{"duplicate": `{"kind":"CHANGE_GOAL",` + string(raw[1:]), "case": strings.Replace(string(raw), `"kind":`, `"Kind":`, 1), "trailing": string(raw) + ` {}`, "actor injection": `{"student_id":"PRIVATE_CANARY",` + string(raw[1:]), "timestamp injection": `{"created_at":"2026-10-05T00:00:00Z",` + string(raw[1:]), "null": strings.Replace(string(raw), `"mutations":[]`, `"mutations":null`, 1), "private nested": strings.Replace(string(raw), `"scope":{`, `"scope":{"solution":"PRIVATE_CANARY",`, 1), "oversized": strings.Repeat(" ", domain.MaximumPlanningSnapshotRequestBytes+1)}
	var body map[string]any
	json.Unmarshal(raw, &body)
	delete(body, "expected_path_revision")
	missing, _ := json.Marshal(body)
	cases["missing"] = string(missing)
	for name, body := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			capture := &intentRouteCapture{}
			status, response := request(body, "STUDENT", "POST", url, capture)
			if status != 400 || capture.creates != 0 || strings.Contains(response, "PRIVATE_CANARY") {
				t.Fatalf("malformed admitted%d calls%d %s", status, capture.creates, response)
			}
		})
	}
}
